assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease.
The atherosclerotic heart disease is documented by diagnosis code I25.10.
The patient reports intermittent episodes of palpitations.
The palpitations are accompanied by dizziness and giddiness.
The symptoms of palpitations, dizziness and giddiness correspond to codes R00.2 and R42.
Mobile cardiac telemetry corresponds to CPT code 93229.
The telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
The telemetry is ordered to assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease.
The patient has known coronary artery disease.
The clinical criteria for this specific diagnostic modality were previously deemed not met.
The denial was issued under CARC code CO-50.
